name: Khatta Meetha
ingredients_raw: Gram Pulse Flour, Edible Vegetable Oil (Cotton Seed, Corn, Palmolein, Ground Nut and Rice Bran), Peanut (8%), Rice Flakes (8%), Sago (7%), Sugar Powder, Green Peas (4%), Gram Pulse (3%), Lentil (2%), Rice Flour, Edible Starch, lodised Salt, Black Salt Powder, *Spices & Condiments (Mango Powder, Turmeric Powder, Cumin Powder, Bishops Weed, Ginger Powder, Black Pepper Powder), Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Leavening Agent (INS 500{i}), Anticaking Agent (INS 551) and Synthetic Food Colour (INS 133). *Used as natural flavouring substances. Allergen Information: Contains Peanuts.
